T: Don't look up. Look at the snacks.
D: Two siblings on a horse ranch try to film the thing hiding in the clouds above their valley.
P: Serve the snacks when the crowd sits down at the western theme park show.
S: Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked paprika and a pinch of chipotle, served in striped paper bags like a park stand.
the Haywood horse ranch in the valley

Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 4mm strips. Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Toss the beef through and marinate overnight. Pat dry and lay on racks over trays. Dry at 75C with the oven door propped open a crack for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but still bendy.
Jupiter's Claim, the western theme park out in the desert
Pinto beans simmered with bacon, onion, chilli and molasses in a cast-iron pot until thick and smoky.
M: the family horse ranch in California
Tri-tip or rump cap rubbed with salt, pepper and garlic, grilled over coals, rested and sliced, with pinto beans and fresh salsa.
waiting all night with the cameras pointed up

Lime and garlic marinated skirt steak grilled hot and wrapped in big flour tortillas with rice, pinto beans, cheese, pico de gallo and chipotle sour cream. Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. Cook 200g rice. Warm 1 drained tin pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime for pico de gallo. Grill the steak on a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Fill 4 large warm tortillas with rice, beans, steak, grated cheese, pico and sour cream mixed with 1 chopped chipotle, then roll tight.
W: Two soft chocolate cookies sandwiching a dome of marshmallow filling, rolled at the edges in silver sprinkles.
K: Blended watermelon and lime, strained and served over ice, sweet and very cold. Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar.

s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, then stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, a pinch of chipotle powder and fine salt. Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.

s.note: Jupiter's Claim, the western theme park out in the desert
s.how: Fry 150g diced bacon and 1 onion in a cast-iron pot until golden. Add 2 cans drained pinto beans, 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, 2 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 250ml water. Simmer 30 minutes until thick and smoky, and serve in tin cups.

m.note: the family horse ranch in California
m.how: Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then 180g flour. Bake 16 small rounds at 175C for 9 minutes. Sandwich pairs with a marshmallow each, warm 1 minute to melt, then roll the edges in silver sprinkles.

d.how: Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar. Strain into a jug, add 250ml cold water and serve over ice with mint.
